description: Fix broken wkhtmltopdf dependency and improve CSS to match Notion's light theme with proper code block rendering

userStories.title: Remove wkhtmltopdf dependency
userStories.description: As a user, I want the script to work without wkhtmltopdf so that I can generate PDFs without installing unavailable packages.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove wkhtmltopdf from ensure_dependency calls in notionify.sh
Keep only pandoc as a required dependency
Pandoc command remains: pandoc input.md -t html -o output.pdf -c ~/.notionify/notion.css
Script runs successfully without wkhtmltopdf installed
Typecheck passes (shellcheck notionify.sh has no errors)

userStories.title: Update CSS color palette to Notion light theme
userStories.description: As a user, I want softer colors that match Notion's actual light theme so the output looks professional.
acceptanceCriteria: Change --notion-text from #2f3437 to #37352f (Notion's actual text color)
Change --notion-muted from #6b6f76 to #787774
Change --notion-border from #e3e3e3 to #e9e9e7
Change --notion-code-bg from #f4f5f7 to #f7f6f3 (warmer gray)
Change --notion-code-text to #37352f (same as body text)
Change --notion-quote from #9aa0a6 to #787774
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix code block overflow and wrapping
userStories.description: As a user, I want code blocks to wrap properly so long lines don't get cut off in PDFs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add white-space: pre-wrap to pre element
Add word-break: break-word to pre element
Add overflow-wrap: break-word to code element
Remove overflow-x: auto from pre (not useful in PDF)
Long code lines wrap instead of being cut off
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Improve inline code styling for PDF
userStories.description: As a user, I want inline code to be clearly visible with proper padding in PDF output.
acceptanceCriteria: Inline code padding increased to 0.2em 0.4em
Inline code border-radius set to 3px
Inline code has subtle border: 1px solid var(--notion-border)
Inline code background clearly visible in PDF
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add print-specific CSS fixes
userStories.description: As a user, I want the PDF output to render correctly with all styles applied.
acceptanceCriteria: Add explicit background-color to code/pre in @media print (backgrounds often disabled in print)
Add -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact to body for color preservation
Add print-color-adjust: exact to body
Ensure code block backgrounds render in PDF output
Typecheck passes
